title: Benchmark knowledge scenarios: a scenario question set and kb content for absent questions
goal: The question pool holds a scenario question set whose rows carry the expected outcome of five knowledge scenarios: present, present in part, not present, off-kb and stale source; FSMO role transfer, DHCP failover and SQL Server availability group automatic seeding move from not present to present, measured by pack before and after; and pool check flags a committed check alternative that no kb line states
